example_sentences_in_bangla: চোদ্দবার না করেছি, তবু নিষেধ শুনলো না।
সে চোদ্দবার বলেছে যে যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: I didn't do it fourteen times, yet he didn't listen to the prohibition.
He said fourteen times that he wouldn't go.
note: This idiom uses numerical exaggeration typical in Bengali for emphasizing frequency.
